A set of online digital tools aimed at providing technical support and decision-making in livestock farming, especially in pasture-based systems, including load and farm indicator calculators for production planning and farm performance analysis; the MEGanE and enPastoreo tools, aimed at grazing management and pasture management; the Livestock Environmental Assessment, aimed at analyzing the environmental aspects of livestock systems; the Green Folder, used for recording and monitoring production information; the pasture growth visualizer, which supports forage monitoring; and the Index on Food Plate (IsPC), an indicator used to evaluate the supply and availability of forage.
